crop.notes: One paragraph from 'Sports at Hot Springs: Veterans Who Attended the Recent Pugilistic Fiasco' (headline not in clipping). The Allen part is complete; the bottom right is covered by a paper flaw that hides the end of the following sentences about Bob Farrell.

ocr.notes: First letters of many lines dropped ('ittracted', 'Natkins', 'eather'); 'Allen's apg' should be 'Allen's backing'; the end is garbled where the paper flaw is.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch noted that Fred Watkins of St. Louis, who backed Tom Allen in all his great battles in America, had made a fortune in the leather business and had come to Hot Springs for the failed championship fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Sunday Post-Dispatch, Part Four, St. Louis, Sunday Morning, November 10, 1895'.

facts.fact: Fred Watkins of St. Louis backed Allen in all his great battles in America, furnishing his backing about twenty years earlier

notes: Allen appears only as the man Watkins backed; 'passing' fits better than 'secondary'. Article 922 is the end of the same article.
